SELECT rm.room_id AS roomId,
u.user_id AS opponentId, u.name AS opponentName, u.profile_img AS opponentProfileImg,
(SELECT c.message FROM chat c WHERE c.room_id = rm.room_id ORDER BY c.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage,
(SELECT c.chat_at FROM chat c WHERE c.room_id = rm.room_id ORDER BY c.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastChatAt,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat c WHERE c.room_id = rm.room_id AND c.chat_id > COALESCE(rm.last_read_chat_id, 0) AND c.sender_id != #{userId}) AS unreadCount
FROM room_members rm JOIN room_members rm2 ON rm.room_id = rm2.room_id AND rm2.user_id != #{userId} JOIN users u ON u.user_id = rm2.user_id WHERE rm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(lastChatAt, '1970-01-01') DESC
SELECT user_id FROM room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY user_id
